lia: uploaded two quick mocks for the streaming row — variant A (split actions: Stop | Regenerate) and variant B (single toggle that becomes Retry after stopping). dropping images in the thread. which do we think is less surprising? kevin: split actions. regen as a separate button feels clearer and prevents accidental restart when trying to stop. maria: agree with kevin. one product question tho — when you Stop, do we keep the partial response in the chat or discard? important for edit+rerun flows. lia: we keep the partial content in place and let the user edit. Stop = pause and lock the partial output for editing; Regenerate always starts fresh unless you explicitly edit. jon: token counter note: current design updates the token badge every chunk and it feels jumpy during long streams. can we provide a two-line micro-state: tokens_sent (live) and model_limit (static) so users understand headroom? e.g. "123 / 4096" but the left number should ease in instead of flashing. tasha: from infra POV continuous per-chunk telemetry is expensive for hosted. engineering suggestion: throttle UI token updates to 200ms and emit on chunk boundaries. that'll make it feel smooth without blowing up events. lia: accessibility nit: should we change the label 'Stop' -> 'Interrupt' for clarity with screen readers? kevin: "Interrupt" reads a little technical to me. "Stop generation" is longer but explicit. we can keep compact label "Stop" but add aria-label="Stop generation". maria: +1 aria-label. also add a tooltip on hover that shows shortcut, e.g. "Esc to stop" — we'll advertise keyboard shortcut in docs. jon: also propose a11y behavior for the partial stream container: use aria-live="polite" and aria-atomic="false" so assistive tech receives incremental updates without focus jumps. sample markup:```
...streaming chunks...
``` lia: nice — that'll avoid screen readers reading every chunk if the user isn't focused. kevin: small copy tweak for regenerate: current microcopy "Regenerate" could be ambiguous when there were system messages. maybe "Regenerate reply" or "Generate again"? shorter is better. maria: let's standardize on "Regenerate" in the product lexicon but show contextual hint on hover: "Generate a fresh response from the same prompt". jon: prompt library placement: should the prompt drawer push the chat column or overlay? pushing keeps context (token count and history visible), overlay is faster to dismiss. prefer push on large viewports, overlay on mobile. tasha: push layout complicates autosizing and streaming rendering (we need to preserve scroll anchor). if we push, confirm we keep pinned bottom behavior for active stream. engineering ok with push if UX handles scroll anchors. lia: decision proposal: A/B test Split Actions (A) vs Compact Toggle+Retry (B) for 2 weeks on web. both variants will use throttled token updates and aria-live markup. show tooltip with Esc shortcut and aria-labels for buttons. kevin: sounds good. I'll update the HIG and component props: isStopToggle: boolean, showRegenerate: boolean, tokenUpdateThrottleMs: 200. maria: can we also add an experiment metric: percent of sessions where user stops vs regen within 30s, and token-update event count? lia: yes — add telemetry tags: ui.variant=split|compact, action=stop|regenerate, stop_time_ms, token_updates_emitted. ops-bot: reminder: rolling deploy to staging with new streaming client will trigger canary on friday 11:30 PDT. lia: thanks all — I'll create the A/B ticket and attach the mocks + acceptance criteria. :white_check_mark:
